judged_text: The redirect URI was silently changed from the config-driven `/api/integrations/${appConfig.slug}/callback` to a hardcoded "/api/integrations/zoho-bigin/callback", an unexplained objective change unrelated to credential sync. The next contributor who changes appConfig.slug (or copies this pattern to another app) now has two places to update; if slug and the hardcoded string ever diverge the OAuth redirect URI breaks against the provider-registered value.
